summary: Bounded dedicated area-code-hunt shard-B pass over the next three unresolved authoritative U.S. geographic NPAs after 235. Nine organization identities were materialized with separate investigation targets, current-status controls, public communication endpoints where resolved, one explicit fiscal-sponsorship relation, and area-code/locality relations. Two records are deliberately historical/current-status constrained. No individual political affiliation or violent-conduct claim is inferred.

data.research_question: Which public organizations matching or closely adjacent to the requested anarchist, anti-authoritarian, autonomous, mutual-aid and organization-network seed families can be defensibly enumerated from shard-B area codes 253, 256 and 262?
data.method: Dedicated area-code-hunt-v1-expanded pass; authoritative NANPA U.S. geographic-NPA gate; deterministic npa mod 3 sharding; literal code searches for anarchists, anarchist collective, anarchist black cross, Food Not Bombs and mutual aid plus Tacoma/South Puget Sound, Huntsville/North Alabama and Waukesha/Kenosha/southeast Wisconsin locality searches; first-party/public-hub/current-event and historical-archive review; repository dedupe; current-status controls; public communication and organization-edge following. X endpoints were collected through public web/link hubs rather than an official X API; Reddit was discovery-only where surfaced and no official Reddit API was required.
classification_rules: Only current authoritative U.S. geographic NPAs are eligible seeds; invalid, foreign, service, reserved and planned-not-yet-in-service codes are excluded before sharding.
Shard B is NPA mod 3 == 1; completed 202, 205, 208, 214, 217, 220, 223, 229 and 235 were not repeated.
Historical directories and old organization pages are discovery evidence only; old groups are not labeled active without current corroboration.
Anarchist labels are retained only when a source explicitly supports them; non-hierarchical, mutual-aid, bail-fund, civic and Food Not Bombs identities are not silently relabeled anarchist.
Modern area-code locality searches may surface historical organizations; the relation records explicitly avoid implying historical use of modern NPA assignments.
No individual political affiliation is inferred.

findings.notes: Tacoma Mutual Aid Collective remains current-directory-listed but first-party status is unresolved; Serve the People Tacoma has recent campus mutual-aid corroboration; Social Science Club and Reading Room is explicitly anarchist but historical 1913-1914.

At The Root Collective and Rocket City Medic Collective explicitly self-describe as non-hierarchical; Huntsville Bail Fund was followed outward from Rocket City Medic Collective's fiscal-sponsorship edge; Huntsville Food Not Bombs is historical/current-status unresolved.
Both have current first-party 2026 mutual-aid activity. Hands Off Kenosha's Indivisible Kenosha Chapter branding is retained as an identity/affiliation-resolution lead rather than a forced merge.

Exact social endpoints preserved: Tacoma Mutual Aid Collective X/Twitter @AidTacoma and Facebook TacomaMutualAidCollective; Serve the People Tacoma X/Twitter @stp_tacoma; historical Huntsville Food Not Bombs X/Twitter @HSVFNB. Additional public hubs include Puget Sound Linktree, At The Root allmylinks/Action Network, Rocket City Medic Collective Open Collective, Huntsville Bail Fund Open Collective and historical Huntsville FNB Blogspot. WMAN has a YouTube embed but no exact organization channel identity was inferred from the embed.
